text: The trigger should change, not just the quote. My WAIT: last D and W bars red, my candle-flip proxy (C14). The signal is a daily close back above that red bar's high, close_above:bar_high on D, with no Creek pull-in step (C27, C19). BULLISH_BOS, pct_from_pivot 0.8, rs_rank_pct 86.66. reclaim:ma_20 is not my trigger either: a swing dip entry on a position-system case. 'Buy the pullback into value' is not my reason and should not stand as why_agreed under a high-break trigger. Wrong if trade under bar_low after the red bar, or a daily close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d).
